summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of preserving the 'SameSite' attribute when deleting cookies, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch sets the 'SameSite' attribute using the session cookie settings, which may not be appropriate for all cookies. This could lead to unexpected behavior if other parts of the application rely on different 'SameSite' settings.
The patch introduces a new line without proper alignment, which slightly deviates from the project's coding style conventions.
